title: Final Indices of Refraction
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the two possible indices of refraction for the wave in the dextrose solution.

title: Electric Field Solutions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the corresponding electric field expressions for each index of refraction.

title: Faraday Rotation Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the expression for the angle of rotation phi in terms of L, gamma, and omega.

title: Correct Use of Maxwell's Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply Maxwell's equations to derive the relationship between D, E, and P.

title: Matrix Determinant Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the determinant correctly to find the conditions for non-zero solutions.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign errors when manipulating equations related to k and the indices of refraction.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Approximation Justification
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the approximation used for small values of gamma omega/c.

title: Physical Interpretation
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide a physical interpretation of the results, such as the significance of the rotation angle.
